name: standmeet-pagestore-mcp
description: microsite.store block (JS): a stdio-MCP server whose 3 tools read, search and append to the store of the microsite a visitor's turn is asked on (a shared manuscript the visitors write with the agent). Forwards to the host over STANDMEET_HOST_SOCKET; owns no data. As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural.
